summary: Master community engagement using IAP2® and ABCD frameworks. Build trust, secure social license, and empower stakeholders. Professional 5-day course.
lede: Building community trust is the practice of creating transparent, reciprocal relationships between organizations and the communities affected by their work. For community relations, social impact, public affairs and project professionals, this training develops practical skills in stakeholder mapping, interest-based negotiation and participatory planning, alongside methods for handling grievances and measuring social impact so community feedback can inform decisions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is designed for professionals who manage the intersection between organizational operations and community interests.
audience: Project Managers in infrastructure or extractive industries
modules: Foundations of Community Trust and Social License
Communication and Digital Trust in the AI Era
Measuring Trust and Social Impact Metrics
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in community relations, CSR, ESG, or public affairs. Familiarity with basic project management concepts and stakeholder engagement principles is recommended.
